title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #8

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which health benefit does wudhu give? (1 mark)
   A. It causes sleep
   B. It makes us thirsty
   C. It stops hunger
   D. It removes germs from exposed body parts

2. Who owns all creatures? (1 mark)
   A. Allah
   B. Farmers
   C. Zoos
   D. The government

3. What is one reward of being good to parents? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Trouble
   C. Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   D. Loss

4. Which activity is not allowed in Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Betting on a game
   B. Swimming
   C. Running
   D. Playing football fairly

5. What is sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. Charity given to please Allah
   B. A loan
   C. A tax
   D. A game

6. What should you do when the adhan is called during a game? (1 mark)
   A. Continue the game
   B. Stop, make wudhu and pray
   C. Turn off the radio
   D. Ask for extra time

7. Which is a good habit for keeping the environment safe for animals? (1 mark)
   A. Throw plastic in rivers
   B. Burn plastic
   C. Leave litter
   D. Put rubbish in bins

8. Which is a good reply to a parent's call? (1 mark)
   A. "Leave me alone."
   B. "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   C. Silence
   D. Shouting

9. Who was the Prophet's close friend who believed at once? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Abu Lahab
   D. Abu Jahl

10. What is dua? (1 mark)
   A. Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   B. A type of food
   C. A game
   D. A journey

11. Which dua matches the name As-Salam? (1 mark)
   A. Grant us peace in our home and country
   B. Let me win
   C. Make me famous
   D. Give me many toys

12. Who was the boy taught the manners of eating in the hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   B. Abu Jahl
   C. Ali as an old man
   D. Bilal

13. Which prayer begins at midday after the sun passes its highest point? (1 mark)
   A. Maghrib
   B. Isha
   C. Dhuhr
   D. Fajr

14. How should we describe Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Like a big man
   B. Like a king on earth
   C. Like an angel
   D. Nothing is like Him

15. What is the plural of rukn? (1 mark)
   A. Sunan
   B. Arkan
   C. Shuruut
   D. Suwar

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain why wudhu is important in the life of a Muslim. (4 marks)

17. Explain how Prophet Ayyub (A.S.) showed patience. (3 marks)

18. Write the meaning of the first verse of Surah Al-Ikhlas, "Qul huwallahu ahad". (2 marks)

19. How did Khadija (R.A.) comfort the Prophet (S.A.W.)? (3 marks)

20. Give three manners of making dua. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — It removes germs from exposed body parts
   Washing keeps us clean.

2. A — Allah
   We are caretakers.

3. C — Blessing and Allah's pleasure
   It is among the best deeds.

4. A — Betting on a game
   Gambling is forbidden.

5. A — Charity given to please Allah
   Sadaqah is voluntary charity.

6. B — Stop, make wudhu and pray
   Prayer must not be delayed by play.

7. D — Put rubbish in bins
   Animals may eat plastic.

8. B — "Yes, Mama, I am coming."
   Politeness.

9. B — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was called As-Siddiq.

10. A — Calling upon Allah and asking Him
   Dua means supplication.

11. A — Grant us peace in our home and country
   As-Salam is the Source of Peace.

12. A — Umar ibn Abi Salamah
   He lived in the Prophet's home.

13. C — Dhuhr
   Dhuhr begins after the sun passes noon.

14. D — Nothing is like Him
   Allah is not compared to His creation.

15. B — Arkan
   Arkan means pillars.

SECTION B
----
16. (4 marks)
   Answer: It is required for prayer; it cleans and refreshes; it brings reward; it prepares the heart for meeting Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: He was tested with illness and loss. He did not complain against Allah, called upon Him, and Allah healed him.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the test, 1 mark for not complaining, 1 mark for calling upon Allah.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say: He is Allah, the One.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for "Say" and 1 mark for "Allah is One".

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: She covered him with a blanket, reminded him of his good character and said Allah would not disgrace him, and took him to Waraqa.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: Begin with praise, face the Qibla and raise hands, be humble, be patient, say Amin.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
